newsitem.title: ITALY: ATHLETICS-TERGAT AIMS FOR THIRD WORLD CROSS-COUNTRY TITLE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-TERGAT AIMS FOR THIRD WORLD CROSS-COUNTRY TITLE.

text.p: Kenya's Paul Tergat is aiming to capture a rare third successive world cross country title on Sunday.
No other man, except for his compatriot John Ngugi, has achieved such a feat since the International Amateur Athletic Federation (IAAF) took over the administration of the competition in 1973.
Tergat remains sanguine about his chances of success.
